title: Kestrel and the Autopsy
author: Isandro Iversen
blurb: Sebastian Oyelaran, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
